subject: Reintroducing new champion + reset of evaluation roadmap (FinLytics)
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
To: Alex Carver <alex.carver@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-09-12T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Reintroducing new champion + reset of evaluation roadmap (FinLytics)

Hi Alex —

Thanks for the heads-up on the org change and for taking the new champion role. Wanted to reintroduce the team and propose a short reset so we can align the evaluation plan and realistic close timeline. We saw momentum stall after the procurement pause; with you stepping in as champion we should be able to get things back on track.

Quick summary / ask:
- Objective: 4-week technical eval + procurement signoff for a production pilot (targeting low-latency chat & embeddings).
- Next milestone: confirm evaluation scope and sample data access by end of next week (Fr, 9/18).
- Owner: Alex (champion) + Kimberly (account) + Marcus (SE).

I've attached an updated MAP (FinLytics_MAP_v2_Redwood_Eval.xlsx) with suggested milestones, roles, and a short list of technical prerequisites (data sample, VPN access, secure S3/ingest config). Marcus, can you call out anything missing on the SE side? Vanessa, I included the procurement checklist we used in similar deals.

If that timeline looks tight, propose alternate dates and we'll adapt. Happy to run a 30-min MAP-kickoff call tomorrow or Thursday.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com | (415) 555-0187
Redwood Inference

Attachments: FinLytics_MAP_v2_Redwood_Eval.xlsx, Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf
From: Alex Carver <alex.carver@finlytics.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Cc: Lisa Wong <lisa.wong@finlytics.com>
Date: 2027-09-13T10:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Reintroducing new champion + reset of evaluation roadmap (FinLytics)

Hi Kimberly —

Thanks for the update and for pulling this together. Happy to pick this up as champion. The 4-week eval + procurement signoff sounds reasonable but we need a small extension on the sample data work — legal wants an anonymized subset before we share anything production-like.

Proposed ramp:
- Week 0 (this week): finalize MAP & obtain legal sign-off on data subset (Lisa is looping in).
- Week 1: delivery of anonymized sample and configuration access. Marcus to validate ingest and initial latency targets.
- Week 2–3: run eval scenarios (chat latency, embedding recall) and produce quality/ops report.
- Week 4: procurement review + pilot agreement signature.

I can do a kickoff call Thu 9/16 at 11:00 AM PT. If that works for the team, we can lock it.

Alex
Director, Data Products — FinLytics
alex.carver@finlytics.com | (212) 555-1212

Alex / Kimberly —

Thanks — quick notes from the SE side after reviewing the attached MAP:
- Data access: anonymized S3 bucket + read-only IAM role will be fine. We can validate schema with a <1000-row sample first.
- Performance baseline: please include expected peak RPS and target p95 latency for chat; that will determine our batching and KV cache settings.
- Test harness: I'll upload a simple Jupyter-based runner in the shared Drive folder (link below) so FinLytics can run smoke tests locally.
- Infra ask: if you want a production-like test, we need a small NAT/VPC peering window (~2 hours) so we can simulate egress latency. Optional but helpful.

I'll add a short tech checklist into the MAP spreadsheet and populate the Drive folder tonight: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-FinLytics-MAP

Marcus Lin
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com
